answer: Cross-Cluster Contribution Consistency. Each agent’s actions form a sparse graph; the mechanism measures whether newly joining identities contribute only inside one tight cluster or span independent clusters like an oasis feeding many routes. A quill marks every distinct cluster touched; identities whose quill count stays near one while volume grows are flagged. Enforcement retroactively downweights their influence. An attacker must sustain genuine cross-cluster work, widening the canyon between clone cost and real participation.
